name: rounds
description: Scheduled task agents that collect data from your trackers, run a prompt through a language model, and store the result.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-language.mjs && node scripts/check-dependencies.mjs && node scripts/check-unit-tests.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/check-unit-tests.mjs && npm run compile:tests && mocha "out/**/*.unit.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
